first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: green soccer field
entities.identification: The green grass occupying the main part of the image, with white markings including the end line, penalty area, goal area, and penalty arc.

entities.name: sideline advertising barrier
entities.identification: Long rectangular advertising boards arranged along the outer edge of the field, with various background colors, text, and graphics.

entities.name: group of players in green clothing
entities.identification: Three players wearing green shirts and shorts with white knee-high socks; the far-side member extends a leg and falls to the ground in the latter part.

entities.name: group of players in dark clothing
entities.identification: A group of players wearing blue-and-black vertically striped shirts, dark shorts, and knee-high socks, with three people visible in the first frame and two in the last frame.

entities.name: Person D
entities.identification: The goalkeeper wearing a bright orange jersey, shorts, and knee-high socks, who adjusts position in front of Object D and dives sideways to make a save.

entities.name: soccer ball
entities.identification: The small white ball that flies from the near side of the penalty area toward the vicinity of the far-side player, changes direction, and then enters the net of Object D.

entities.name: Object D
entities.identification: The white goal defended by Person D, with posts on both sides, a crossbar, and a light-colored net extending backward.

entities.name: gray tiered stands
entities.identification: The gray stands in the upper left of the image, with repeated rows of empty seats, steps, longitudinal dividers, and railings.

entities.name: off-field group of people in vests
entities.identification: A group of people outside the field wearing bright yellow or orange vests with dark lower garments, including standing and seated people.

entities.name: off-field gray rigid passageway
entities.identification: The continuous gray ground strip between the area below the stands and the sideline advertising facilities.

entities.name: white advertising surface beyond the end line
entities.identification: Two large white-background advertising surfaces beyond the end line on both sides of Object D, with large black text and red graphics.
